data.description: A sceaduinar's natural attacks can strike incorporeal creatures as if they were ghost touch weapons.  All of a sceaduinar's natural attacks deal +1d6 points of negative energy damage to the target.  This energy does not heal creatures healed by inflict spells.
data.name: Entropic Touch
